entities.summary: Hassan II Stadium is an under construction football stadium being built in the commune of El Mansouria, Benslimane Province, Morocco, just east of Casablanca. Once completed in 2028, it will serve as the home of the Morocco national football team, and replace the Stade Mohammed V as the home stadium of Morocco's largest clubs; Raja CA and Wydad AC.
